subject: Literature
title: The Sonnets and Private Shakespeare
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Sonnets and Private Shakespeare.

hook.text: Shakespeare wrote one hundred fifty-four sonnets, and scholars have spent centuries trying to decode their secrets.

buildup.text: The first one hundred twenty-six are addressed to a young man, and the rest to a mysterious 'Dark Lady.'

discovery.text: The sonnets contain some of the most beautiful love poetry ever written in any language.

twist.text: The intense love poems to a young man have fueled endless debate about Shakespeare's own sexuality.

climax.text: The sonnets remain the most intimate window into Shakespeare's mind, yet they reveal less than they promise.

punchline.text: His most personal poems are his greatest mystery.

quiz.question: Why are Shakespeare's sonnets controversial?
options: They were written in a foreign language
Love poems addressed to a young man fuel debate about his sexuality
